column3: The character from the FIRST image is H: keep him EXACTLY the same face (bald, white letter H on the forehead), big muscular body, black shorts, olive tactical belt, black wrist wraps, same semi-realistic comic illustration style, natural proportions, normal round head, nothing squashed or distorted. Realistic and believable, NO fantasy effects (no glow aura, no lightning, no speed lines). The SECOND image is the colour formula to copy: top half dark red #7A1A1A, bottom half teal-green #0F8B85, split by a torn diagonal paper edge, big white extra-bold text with thick black outline, white label boxes with black outline. Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts cover, 1080x1920, sharp, simple, readable on a small phone in one second; the picture must clearly show the video topic: calf raises done WRONG (fast bouncing) vs RIGHT (heels deep below the step, slow, big calves). Keep all text and faces inside the middle 60 percent of the height. No other text, no watermark. TOP red half: H BIG, cropped from the head down to the feet filling the whole width of the red half, side view on a grey step, bouncing with very thin weak stick-like calves, a white label box with a big red X: "BOUNCING". BOTTOM teal-green half: H BIG, same framing, side view on the same step, heels deep below the step edge, very big round muscular calves twice as thick, a white label box with a big green check: "SLOW". Big white text on the torn edge: "SKINNY CALVES?".
